expect_red: a feature whose partners sit on two sides of its part has a pin toward each, neither route enters its own part's box past its stub, and one hover lights both pins of the one feature

mutations.contract: Each of a feature's pins faces its own interface's partner, never the first interface's.
mutations.note: Declared with the guard by handoff a_map_pin_faces_each_partner_and_no_two_routes_share_a_run (2026-11-19). Puts every pin of a feature on the side facing its FIRST interface's partner, as the map did before: model v2's tangential-link attach bore on the plate then sends its route to the bushing back across the plate's own box.
mutations.find: var side = sideFor(f.part, farPart, iface.id + "|" + f.id);
mutations.replace: var side = sideFor(f.part, farPartOf(ifaces[0], f.id), iface.id + "|" + f.id);

mutations.contract: A feature's several pins are drawn as one entity, so a hover on it lights every one.
mutations.note: Declared with the guard by handoff a_map_pin_faces_each_partner_and_no_two_routes_share_a_run (2026-11-19). Draws a group per pin instead of per feature: the map then draws the feature twice and a hover lights each pin alone.
